title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Mon 23 Nov
summary: A moderate day (forecast moderate). Thermals were strongest (moderate) about 13:00 to 15:00. The upslope ran from about 09:15 to about 16:00. A high day for November: the base reached about 6,100 ft (normal 4,500–5,500 ft). Yesterday evening, the page called it normal, about 5,200 ft, a miss. Midday the base averaged about 5,800 ft by the Kekoa camera, 600 ft higher than yesterday evening's number; the morning update said about 5,200 ft, off by 600 ft; at 10:00, from the 09:00 base, about 5,500 ft, off by 300 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest south about 13:07, crossing Kula Highway at the middle Lower Kula Road junction. Data gaps: no readings all day from 1 station (Nakula); Upper Kahikinui stopped at 15:25; Kahikinui stopped at 15:30; the Mesonet could not be reached on 43 of 51 updates.
